title: Veyra Document Viewer
description: Open Word, PowerPoint and Excel files right in VS Code: .docx with real pages, .pptx slides with a presenter mode, .xlsx sheets with formulas, plus CSV and TSV. Search, zoom and copy text. Free, offline, nothing uploaded.

title: Dolphin Walkthroughs for Flutter
description: See the widget tree of any Flutter page, double-click a widget and turn it into a dolphin walkthrough step. Every dolphin option in one form, written into your code or JSON config.

title: Git Graph Veyra
description: See your repository as a graph: every branch, merge and tag, with commit details, diffs and one-click actions like checkout, cherry-pick and revert. Free, fast and private.
